title: 1410. Sum of Digits in a Triangle Pattern

Problem Statement:
Write a program that generates a triangle pattern using the digits of a given number and computes the sum of all digits displayed in the triangle. 
Input Description:
1. First line: A positive integer n (with at least 1 digit)
2. Second line: An integer r (number of rows in the triangle, 1 ≤ r ≤ 20) 
Output Description:
A single integer: The sum of all digits printed in the triangle 
Sample Input:
123
3 
Sample Output:
1
2 3
1 2 3
12
